title: A maximal-degree nonzero ANF coefficient
statement: Let $f$ be a nonzero Boolean function on $\mathbb F_2^n$. There is a set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ whose algebraic normal form coefficient is nonzero and whose cardinality equals the algebraic degree of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a nonzero Boolean function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
